en.headline: Financial Secretary leads delegation to Nanjing starting Monday
en.dek: Paul Chan will attend a Jiangsu-Hong Kong promotion conference and visit technology firms and Nanjing University during the two-day trip.
body: Financial Secretary Paul Chan will depart for Nanjing on Monday morning leading a delegation of more than 30 members from public bodies, innovation parks, professional organisations and enterprises.

The group will attend a promotion conference themed “Jiangsu-Hong Kong Partnership: Setting Sail Together” on Tuesday, aimed at highlighting Hong Kong’s role as a platform for mainland firms expanding overseas, and will hold business matching and exchange sessions.

Chan is also scheduled to visit technology transfer institutions and green-tech and biotech firms in Jiangsu, deliver a speech at Nanjing University, meet Hong Kong business people in the province, and call on provincial and city leaders. He returns on Tuesday afternoon; Deputy Financial Secretary Michael Wong will act in his absence.

zh.headline: 財政司司長周一率團赴南京 推廣港作內地企業出海平台
zh.dek: 陳茂波將出席蘇港推介大會，並到訪創科企業及南京大學，期間副司長黃偉綸署任。
body: 財政司司長陳茂波將於周一上午率領超過30人的代表團前往南京訪問，成員包括多個公營機構、創科園區、專業團體及金融、法律、電子商務等領域企業負責人。
代表團將於周二出席以「蘇港攜手‧揚帆啓航」為主題的推介大會，向內地企業推廣香港作為國際業務平台的優勢，並參與商務對接及交流活動，同時介紹本港創科生態。
陳茂波亦會參訪江蘇技術轉移機構及綠色科技、生物科技企業，到南京大學演講，並與在蘇港商會面及拜會省市領導。他將於周二下午回港，期間財政司副司長黃偉綸署任。
